key_insight: PhysiBench is an open benchmark suite that pairs 612 executable intracellular Boolean model variants with 120,000 multiscale stochastic simulations for evaluating systems-biology methods.
engineering_relevance: It provides a reproducible testbed for surrogate modeling, inference, optimization, and benchmarking in multiscale computational biology pipelines.
method: Built 612 Boolean network variants from 7 published intracellular regulatory models using mutation-based construction.
Filtered variants with online behavioral checks and offline sensitivity evaluation.
Generated 120,000 time-resolved stochastic simulations from 60 selected models under sampled stimulation protocols.
evidence_signal: The resource was validated through file-integrity and executability checks, plus graph-structural diversity and behavioral heterogeneity analyses of simulation outputs.
watch_item: Because trajectories depend on stochastic seeds, sampling protocol, and fixed initial configurations, results may be sensitive to benchmark setup and reproducibility details.
paper_title: A benchmark suite of intracellular Boolean model variants and multiscale simulations for computational biology
